sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To say 'in the restaurant', add -ben to étterem: étteremben. Because étterem's vowels are front (é, e), the front-vowel suffix -ben is used, not the back-vowel -ban.

items.spanish: Jó napot kívánok! Itt az étlap.

sections.content: Étterem doesn't drop its vowel before -ben (étteremben), but it DOES before the accusative -t (éttermet) — the same noun behaves differently depending on which suffix follows.
